verdict.rationale: Framer's docs show AI-driven bulk operations. The CMS agent imported 39 CSV rows into a collection and linked them to 10 category rows, and it can set up and update an entire CMS. The site agent applies site-wide typography, brand-color and dark-mode changes across all components, and external agents can create, update and delete CMS items in bulk on a reviewable branch. Missing for 10: a documented batch API or explicit limits for programmatic bulk edits, details on plugin-based bulk editing, and any independent or hands-on corroboration (the evidence is vendor marketing examples only).
